We just added automated rollout detection to our platform, which will monitor all software updates released in the last 30 days.

The post will include the percentage increase and list all models included in the wave, such as "Model Y AI4".

Keep an eye out for the first rollout!

To clarify, this enables automated posts here on X, just like our software update posts.

We'll be adding a dedicated section for this to our web platform this week, and our iOS app will support receiving rollout notifications before month end.

Hey @Tesla community, what would make visualizing rollouts easier for everyone?

Every wave, we'll see dozens of posts (and replies) across X of those who were not included, even when a wave might be as small as 1-3% (so the majority are expected not to receive it yet).

But if it's being expressed as a question about whether a wave actually occurred, then that's something we believe should be improved.

We can work with other platforms such as @wholemars's @fsd_database and @TezLabApp, alongside our own platform, to help tackle these problems.

Just some food for thought. We appreciate and try to engage with everyone, whether the posts or replies are positive, neutral, or negative, and whether such feelings are directed toward us or at Tesla.

Always striving to be more helpful to all. Let us know any thoughts you have!
